name: Hi Energy
description: Hi Energy connects Claude to your authenticated affiliate marketing account. Search advertisers and programs across major networks, inspect deals and promotions, look up contacts, review transactions and clicks, choose the right performance report, generate tracking links, and run scoped publisher workflows—using the same permissions you already have in Hi Energy.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Hi Energy to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Hi Energy to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://app.hienergy.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Hi Energy MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hi Energy lists 60 MCP tools, including add_publisher_account_admin, build_advertiser_search_links, create_referred_user, enrich_publisher_from_domain, find_more_contacts, find_publisher_linkedin_users, generate_deeplink, get_account_activity_summary, get_advertiser, get_advertiser_contacts, get_agency, and get_api_schema.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Hi Energy?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Hi Energy in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.

_published_faq.name: Does Hi Energy MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hi Energy requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Hi Energy is developed by Hi Energy Agency LLC. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
